title: Boston canonical geospatial — BUILDING unit, Stage 1A.1 candidate
description: NOT the production schema. Extends the Stage 1A part-level candidate with a BUILDING level. A BUILDING is a DERIVED grouping over PRESERVED factual ROOF PARTS: parts are never discarded, merged away, or rewritten. Geometry stays PDDL (City of Boston Buildings with Roof Breaks); identity is DERIVED from an authoritative external identifier (MassGIS Building Structures LOCAL_ID), never from a geometric heuristic.

identity.description: Where building identity comes from. If this block is absent, there is no defensible building level and consumers must fall back to the roof-part unit.

tier.description: DERIVED = an authoritative identifier supplied the grouping. INFERRED = a heuristic did. Stage 1A.1 emits only DERIVED; a heuristic path was tested and rejected.

id.description: ms-<LOCAL_ID> when grouped; solo-<partId> when not

localId.description: MassGIS LOCAL_ID — the authoritative building identifier

basis.description: ungrouped-ambiguous = the part straddles two parent structures and was deliberately NOT grouped; ungrouped-no-parent = no parent structure covers it

areaM2.description: DERIVED: sum of constituent part areas

heightM.description: DERIVED range over constituent parts. Deliberately a RANGE, never a single collapsed height: a stepped building must not become a box in the data model.

heightsByPartFt.description: FACT, in source feet: every constituent part's own height and base/roof elevations, preserved so stepped massing survives.

assignment.description: How each part was attached: overlap coverage against its parent structure and the margin over the runner-up. A low margin is what marks AMBIGUOUS.

boundaryEdgeCount.description: DERIVED: constituent edges surviving the dissolve (edges shared by two siblings of the same building are removed; party walls and courtyards are not).

parts.description: The PRESERVED factual roof parts, verbatim from the Stage 1A PDDL fixture. A building never replaces its parts.

notes: FACT: part rings, part elevations in source feet, part attributes. All from the PDDL layer.
DERIVED: the grouping itself (from MassGIS LOCAL_ID), the dissolved boundary, areaM2, heightM range, centroid.
INFERRED: nothing. A geometric fallback was tested against authoritative ground truth and rejected — see the Stage 1A.1 report.

Vertical: elevations remain in source feet and are NOT converted to the game's vertical frame. The City's DOIT_buildings service documents BASE_ELEVATION / TOP_SEA_LEVEL as NAVD88, but those fields are not in the PDDL layer, and the PDDL layer's own *_2010 fields carry no stated vertical reference.
A consumer that cannot honour the AMBIGUOUS basis must fall back to the roof-part unit rather than guessing.
